description: Rename a screenshot set, replace its extra-locale list, and/or reorder its screens. Returns the updated set (with image data stripped). Requires an authorized Sonar account or a write-scope API key.

locales.description: Replaces the extra-locale list (e.g. ["de-DE","fr-FR"]). Locales removed here lose their stored translations.

screen_order.description: Full permutation of the set's screen ids in the new display order.

name: sonar_update_screenshot_set
title: Update Screenshot Set
